opening.argument: The presentation describes Base as an Ethereum Layer 2 built on an open-source stack and shows it as a platform for building applications and games. Its “10X cheaper than Ethereum” statement is a historical 90-day average cost comparison, not a promise of financial return. The description also says the material is not intended as investment advice. The displayed base.org address serves as a platform information or promotional reference; there is no request for money or credentials and no requirement to participate financially. Taken together, these are claims about a technology platform and its use, not an offer of investment gains.

citations.quote: An Ethereum L2, incubated by Coinbase and built on the open-source OP Stack.
